commands.name: list_piece_types
commands.description: List registered environment piece types, exact field schemas, defaults and installed model IDs.

commands.name: list_pieces
commands.description: List pieces in the current environment with stable IDs, or inspect one piece by ID. Omit target to list. Pass the returned next_offset as offset for the next page.

commands.name: add_piece
commands.description: Add a registered environment piece. Target is its type. Use the type's fields in piece_values and optional parent ID for a child. Position is local to the parent. Without a root position Euclid places it at the crosshair. Check list_piece_types for defaults and required fields.

commands.name: edit_piece
commands.description: Edit fields of an existing piece by ID. Set only requested fields in piece_values. Material changes merge with existing material fields.

commands.name: remove_piece
commands.description: Remove an environment piece and its children by stable ID. Undo with undo_piece.

commands.name: undo_piece
commands.description: Undo the most recent environment piece edit in the current environment.
